understanding: The pending boolean-count rule is now explicit. Token accuracy, full sequence matching and probability-based loss measure different things; suitable answer metrics depend on whether the task has one required exact form. Missing prompt information also limits what a failure means.
materials_and_labels: True/False comparisons contribute1/0 to sum. Exact match requires equal order, length and values. Probability examples.6/.9 can share the same winning answer while having different negative-log cost.
expected_change: The core question is answered at this point: lower loss does not by itself establish a completed generation task. Any following material should preserve these evaluation limits.
confusion_and_quote: No remaining confusion about unit1 syntax. The story output is an illustrative failure string; I have not checked its experiment provenance and will not treat it as quantified comparison. The location example shows a criterion mismatch when required facts were absent, rather than excusing failures on supplied facts.

concept_checks.identity: Loss evaluates correct-answer probability; token accuracy counts winning labels; sequence exact match tests complete literal equality.
concept_checks.mechanism: Raising correct-answer probability can reduce loss without changing argmax; one wrong position still makes exact matchFalse.
concept_checks.need: Determine whether the model actually accomplishes the requested task rather than mistake a smoother training objective for task success.
concept_checks.usage: Use exact match for fixed labels/arithmetic forms, task-aware criteria for open expression; inspect generated answers alongside loss.
concept_checks.example_scope: Manual arrays and.6/.9 probabilities demonstrate distinctions. A story fragment shows an observed failure's form, without proving a broad quality relation.

concept_checks.identity: An evaluation should require only facts available or inferable from the prompt.
concept_checks.mechanism: If left/right position is absent, literal reproduction of a source containing it cannot reliably recover that detail.
concept_checks.need: Avoid labeling absence of supplied information as failure to use known facts.
concept_checks.usage: Check task clues before interpreting mismatch; changing the handwritten teacher-forced array does not change actual generation behavior.
concept_checks.example_scope: A boundary on interpretation, not evidence that any particular trained model succeeded.
